prompts.prompt: Draw a NEW illustration in exactly the same art style as the attached image: soft Korean webtoon style, clean thin dark outlines, flat muted pastel colors, plain off-white background, two horizontal panels stacked vertically separated by a thin gray line. IMPORTANT: draw NO text, NO letters, NO speech bubbles anywhere. Leave an empty off-white strip at the top of each panel (about 20% of the panel height) for a title to be added later, and leave empty space above the characters' heads. TOP PANEL (1990s): a young woman in 90s fashion (curly permed hair, denim jacket) stands next to an old red public telephone booth on a street corner, checking her wristwatch with an annoyed face, while a young man in a 90s windbreaker runs toward her holding a small bouquet, sweating. BOTTOM PANEL (today): a young Korean couple sit face to face at a small cafe table with two iced coffees, both looking down at their own smartphones, ignoring each other, with neutral faces. Same character proportions and line quality as the reference.
